name: Faro
bio: Faro, the Drowned Keeper. A lighthouse keeper who went down with his light and walked back out of the sea wearing it: where his head should be there is a caged lamp, still burning. He fights at the end of an anchor chain. He drags you in from across the stage, sets mines and geysers where you want to stand, answers your attack through a pane of storm glass, and when he trims the wick the whole fight speeds up.
